angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 518,297 km at 96.30 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.3837 +/- 0.0182 mas (same row, RUWE 0.88): 96.30 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.745 +/- 0.024 solar radii from Mistry et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-181 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.521.1066M/abstract): 518,297 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.822 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Mistry et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-181 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.521.1066M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4994 +/- 50 K from Mistry et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-181 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.521.1066M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mistry et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-181 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.521.1066M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-181.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.609, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-181 (pscomppars): spectral type K, from Mistry et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.521.1066M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-181 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.272 dex, from Mistry et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.521.1066M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-181 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.52578, from Mistry et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.521.1066M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-181 (pscomppars): age 5.4 Gyr, from Mistry et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.521.1066M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-181 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.28 km/s, from Mistry et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.521.1066M/abstract)
